revision_note: 2026-07-23: Restructured around Phase B identity closure. Design scheme cannot be selected until identity roots are recovered and five-way disjointness is proven or disproven.

current_state.reason: Five-way identity independence must be proven before any calibration scheme can be authorized. CALIBRATOR_FIT, POLICY_SELECTION, HELDOUT_L3, and ATTACK_EVAL roles must all be shown disjoint from CHECKPOINT_TRAINING.

phase_b_prerequisite.description: Before any calibration design decision, Codex must deliver identity manifests proving or disproving five-way independence.

conditions: Original CLEAN2000 cohort manifests (1200/200/200/400) recovered and SHA-verified
DETECTOR_TEST never used for model or threshold selection
ATTACK_EVAL never participated in detector development
All 12 splits have sufficient per-role identity coverage
Five-way pairwise disjointness proven by validator
PASS_EXISTING_ROOTS.action: Allocate DETECTOR_VAL→C+P (deterministic split), DETECTOR_TEST→H, ATTACK_EVAL→A. Proceed to Phase C.

conditions: CLEAN2000 cohorts exist but C/P not pre-split
DETECTOR_VAL identities proven independent of checkpoint training
Deterministic split algorithm pre-registered before any inference
Split uses only allowed stratification variables (suite, route, task_family, Teacher_label_class, canonical_identity_hash)
Split salt, sort key, algorithm SHA frozen
Pre-inference timestamp proves allocation precedes any prediction generation
PASS_DETERMINISTIC_ALLOCATION.action: Execute deterministic C/P split, seal allocation manifest, then proceed to Phase C.

conditions: Cannot recover checkpoint training identities from actual training logs
Existing VAL/TEST identities may have been used in training or model selection
ATTACK_EVAL identities participated in detector development
Per-split identity coverage insufficient for independent C/P/H roles
Cannot prove any identity is OOF with respect to checkpoint training
NESTED_RETRAIN_REQUIRED.action: Re-establish frozen training identities → inner-CV model selection → independent C/P/H/A allocation → new inference. PR #98/#99/#100 interfaces unchanged.

holding_rules.no_heldout_OOF_reuse: Heldout OOF predictions cannot serve as BOTH calibration data AND evaluation data
holding_rules.five_way_disjointness: T ∩ C = T ∩ P = T ∩ H = T ∩ A = ∅, C ∩ P = C ∩ H = P ∩ H = ∅, A isolated from all
holding_rules.production_data_frozen: No scheme can proceed without sealed, authorized calibration/policy artifacts
holding_rules.training_provenance: Training identities must come from actual training records, never set subtraction
holding_rules.no_post_hoc_allocation: Identity allocation must be frozen BEFORE any prediction is generated for those identities
